stories.subTitle: UAE v England A, 4th match, Sharjah
stories.summary: An opening stand of 227 between Matt Prior and Vikram Solanki hurried England A to victory over the United Arab Emirates in the fourth and final match of their brief stay in Sharjah

stories.title: Scotland dominate; UAE fight back
stories.subTitle: Intercontinental Cup semi-finals, Sharjah, 2nd day
stories.summary: Kenya must win to reach the final of the ICC Intercontinental Cup after Scotland dominated the second day at Abu Dhabi, while Canada held back UAE's first innings at Sharjah to be the more likley side to progress further
